text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions for gains, then bought some stocks back soon after; I should make each trade follow a clear plan rather than react to the satisfaction of a realized gain.","I held Stock B until it was down about 70% before selling. I should set objective review points and act on deteriorating prospects instead of letting reluctance to admit a mistake dictate my decision.","I bought Stock D and later sold it at a loss. Before buying, I should define why I want to own a stock and what evidence would make me change my mind."]}
